prompt: From a few steps up a narrow cellar staircase, a 28mm lens looks slightly down at a crew gathered at the foot. Closest, his face a good third of the frame, a long-faced Black man of 40 with a high forehead, narrow nose and long chin, clean-shaven, white fedora pushed up, sings up at us, overcoat open, collar flat, revolver hanging low at his thigh. On the right a smashed fuse box showers white-gold sparks that light his mouth; the left sinks into deep blue. Smaller behind him: a square-headed German American of 55, cropped grey hair, duelling scars on one cheek, Thompson aimed at the floor, standing tall on the left; a wiry Greek American of 25 with heavy eyebrows, crouched at right, looking back at the sparks. Thanks.
